more_info.overview: L-cystine is the amino acid formed from two cysteine units linked through sulphur. The FDA amino-acid regulation identifies L-cystine as a permitted amino-acid ingredient under its specified nutritional conditions. This ingredient should be distinguished from L-cysteine preparations used for flour treatment. The chemical name identifies the amino acid, but does not establish the source of a commercial lot.
